input: Set up a monthly automatic donation to charity

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Monthly Automatic Charity Donation
gold.taskDescription: Set up a recurring monthly automatic donation to a charity of the user's choice.

questions.title: Which specific charity or cause do you want to support?
questions.description: Identify the exact organization or type of cause the user wants to donate to.

questions.title: What monthly donation amount do you have in mind?
questions.description: Determine the exact recurring dollar amount the user wants to commit to each month.

questions.title: Which payment method will you use for this donation?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user plans to pay via credit card, bank transfer, PayPal, or another method.

questions.title: Have you donated to this charity before?
questions.description: Understand whether the user already has an account or relationship with the charity, or is starting fresh.

questions.title: What date each month should the donation be charged?
questions.description: Pinpoint the preferred billing date so the recurring schedule can be set accordingly.

questions.title: Do you need this donation to be tax-deductible?
questions.description: Determine if the user requires a registered nonprofit for tax purposes, which may narrow charity options.

questions.title: Is there a total time period or spending cap you want?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants the donation to run indefinitely or stop after a set number of months or total amount.
